name: Neural Scene Flow Fields (NSFF)
definition: A method that takes a monocular video with known camera poses as input, uses depth predictions as a prior, and regularizes by also outputting scene flow, which is used in the loss.
summary: Neural Scene Flow Fields is a dynamic NeRF method that explicitly predicts 3D scene flow and disocclusion weights to handle temporal changes and sharp motion discontinuities in monocular video.
